hypothesis: Bounded local removal at an attributable output branch preserves independently supported sibling values without weakening validation. All proposals require fresh probe, semantic review, selection and development validation.
baseline_policy: Fresh unmodified current runtime, eight sources, fixed supplied evidence, no external acquisition.
candidate_policy: Identical inputs/model/limits; one runtime for all eight and subsequent holdouts.
evaluation: Original frozen labels and independent raw agreement, separate coverage, false acceptance, abstention, missing outputs, complete terminal state and costs. One trajectory per arm; descriptive comparison, not statistical reliability.

holdout_preparation.limitation: CER has no independent positive semantic labels; it tests ambiguity/abstention, not positive extraction accuracy.
